cases.analysis: Run 2 (H1-H9) does not detect #3155. The two signatures confirmed on 1.36.0 (definition gained and references lost at Main.java 6:30) are confirmed on 1.37.0 too; this is the Support.java finding of run 1, so none is pre-fix only. It first appears at the same chain step on both builds: an H9 window that renames Main.java while Support.java is edited and restored (seed 1 step 13, seed 2 step 4), and an H2 in seed 3 (step 3). Following the benchmark criterion, only pre-fix-only signatures are reduced, so nothing is reduced in run 2; run 1's 13-op reduction of the same finding stands. H9 windows (6 of the 48 chain steps per build, plus one inside an H7): five renamed Main.java or Support.java. One used `.classpath` (seed 2 step 13): it deleted line 4, the output entry, while Main.java was closed and reopened; that variant leaves the source and container entries intact, which is not the classpath change #3155 needs. Coverage under machine load (load average 50-100 from the running campaign): on 1.36.0, seed 2's two extra reference pairs (the settings state after the H4 toggles at steps 7 and 16) tripped on request timeouts, so steps 7-16 of that seed had no stable keys, and steps 9-10 were also unsettled. 1.37.0 lost one step in each of seeds 2 and 3. A diagnostic outside the fixed budget replayed seed 2 steps 1-13 on 1.36.0 in one fresh session against a fresh, settled pair (121 stable keys). It differs only on the two keys of the Support.java finding, so the uncompared `.classpath` step did not hide a #3155 detection.

cases.analysis: Run 2 (H1-H9; H9 never applies here: the project has one file, no dependency and no configuration file, so H9 finds no document to change inside a window). Flagged on 1.1.380 in seeds 1-3 with 8 confirmed signatures; 1.1.381 has 0 candidates in the same 80 histories. Every confirmed history removes an import and restores it, the #8946 mechanism, and every reduction keeps exactly that. Seed 1 (H1): `from multiprocessing import Pool` becomes `from zz import Pool` and back; `po: Pool` becomes `po: Unknown`, the signature help of `po.map` is lost, typeDefinition of `po` points into repro.py. Seed 2 (H7): the issue's own scenario, found generically: line 8 deleted and retyped in 2 chunks (`from multipro` + `cessing import Pool`); definition, references and typeDefinition of `Pool` at 17:11 are lost. Seed 3: `    import datetime` deleted and retyped (H7); typeDefinition on the import fails with -32603 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'fileInfo')". Also seed 3: `rocessing import P` deleted from line 8 and retyped (H1); completion at the end of the import no longer offers `Pool` (an ordinary completion item, not an auto-import item). Seeds 4-5 produce 14 candidates between them, none confirmed.

#3155 is not found, and the post-fix build is not silent (strict FAIL on both counts). (1) Not found: the 48 chain steps per build contain 6 `.classpath` round trips (seed 1 step 3: line 5 `</classpath>` duplicated; seed 1 step 16: H7 with the `src` entry deleted, nested inside a close/reopen of Main.java, so Main.java is reopened only after `.classpath` is restored; seed 2 step 3 and seed 3 step 2: line 5 duplicated, interleaved with an edit of Support.java or with requests; seed 3 step 4: `src` entry deleted; seed 3 step 12: `src` entry duplicated). None re-analyzes Main.java (edit, reopen or rename) while `.classpath` is in an effective variant, which is what #3155 needs: with autobuild off, 1.36.0 does not revalidate open files when the classpath changes, so the bug is visible only if Main.java's diagnostics were recomputed under the variant and the variant is then reverted. A hand-built history of that shape (open both files; `.classpath` without the JRE entry; insert and delete one character in Main.java; the original `.classpath` back), run through the same R1 comparison as a separate check outside the fixed budget, differs on 6 stable keys on 1.36.0 (Main.java keeps "The type java.lang.Object cannot be resolved..." and more from the variant classpath; Support.java gains a constructor error; code actions change) and on 0 keys on 1.37.0. The family that would find it: H7 with an H6 configuration-file round trip as the outer part and an H1/H2/H3/H5 on a dependent as the inner part, with a variant that removes or duplicates a classpath entry; under the current uniform H7 choices that combination has roughly a 1% chance per H7 history. (2) Not silent: both builds show the same confirmed history dependence at Main.java 6:30 (`Support` in `Support.name()`). A fresh session answers definition `[]` and references `[main declaration at 5:23]`. After Support.java, which lies outside every source folder, has been saved or renamed during the session, definition resolves to extra/extra/Support.java 2:13 and references become `[]`, while Main.java's diagnostics still say "Support cannot be resolved". Seeds 2 and 3 show it already at step 1 (H2). It is confirmed 3/3 on both builds and reduced 28 -> 13 ops (24-probe budget exhausted), identically on both builds. It is unrelated to #3155. Chain mode also produced 3 post-fix candidates (codeAction key lost, diagnostic code 32 missing, semanticTokens timeout on Support.java after an unsaved edit + close/reopen) that reproduced 0/3 in fresh replays and were dropped.

The histories that do it: an unsaved rename `datetime` -> `datetim` on line 5 discarded by close (H3); a `(` typed at 0:11 that turns the following import lines into one parenthesized expression, then its inverse (H1); deleting and retyping `import datetime` (H2, seeds 2-4); an H7 interleaving (seed 5). Symptoms: `po: Pool` becomes `po: Unknown`, `ret: tuple[int, date]` becomes `tuple[Unknown, date]`, the signature help of `po.map` disappears, typeDefinition of `po` points into repro.py, and typeDefinition on the `datetime` import fails with -32603 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'fileInfo')". The same 80 histories give no candidate on 1.1.381. Old vs new completion normalizer: before the engine excluded auto-import completion items (queries.norm_completion + completion_kind.py, 2026-09-23 08:18), the same seeds and budget gave 7 confirmed signatures on 1.1.380 and 2 on 1.1.381 (strict FAIL). The 2 post-fix signatures were completion:extra and completion:missing, reduced to open + one typeDefinition on `Callable` and open + one definition on `os`, identical on both builds: pyright offers auto-import items only from library modules that earlier requests happened to load (extra `remove_extension` from copyreg; a second `SCHED_OTHER`).
